$schema: Session state manifest v3 - vertical phase slices, programmatic updates only
topic: Click-to-select and drag objects on canvas
description: Add the ability to click an object on the screen and move it around. Click different layers. Brainstorm general approach. Currently, the only way to access a component is through the hierarchy panel, which is awkward.

plan_state.summary: All 5 checkpoints complete: path-tagged DOM, drill-in selection, drag-to-reposition, React SelectionOverlay + 8-handle resize, arrow-key nudge + locked-layer canvas-skip.

open_questions: [DECIDED] Selection model = top-level first, drill in on re-click
How are non-visual layers (audio, some effects) selected — hierarchy-only or placeholder gizmo?
Drag write-back units: preserve center/% semantics or always convert to px?
Multi-select / marquee — in scope or future?
Keyboard nudging, snap-to-center, snap-to-grid — in or out?
Locked / hidden layers — selectable from canvas?
When child selected and user drags inside its bounds: silent parent drag, or re-select parent on drag-start?
Background detection heuristic: full-stage bounds, fit:cover, or first-in-array?
Empty-area click (no bg layer hit) — deselect or no-op?
Resize anchor behavior: how does transform.anchor interact with which handle is dragged?
Drop-from-asset-browser: keep px or convert to % for consistency?
Float precision for drag write-back (2 decimal places?)

high_level: Direct manipulation: canvas becomes primary surface for select+position
Preserve live feel: stage keeps playing/animating during edit
mid_level: Reach into glyph-group sub-layers and foreign media children
Drag selected layer -> writes back to layer.position

key_decisions.title: Selection model: top-level first, drill in on re-click (Figma-style)
key_decisions.rationale: Predictable default + discoverable drill-in without modifiers; preserves "grab the whole thing to drag" affordance.

key_decisions.title: Drag is top-level-only; drill-in is selection-for-inspector
key_decisions.rationale: Glyph-group is the unit of position. Children have no native position field; dragging them would be structurally dishonest.

key_decisions.title: Backgrounds require cmd-click to select
key_decisions.rationale: Plain clicks fall through fullscreen backgrounds so drill-in remains usable on foreground layers. No new schema flag.

key_decisions.title: Two-tier drag rule: glyph-group atomic; generic group is container
key_decisions.rationale: Honors structural model: glyph-group children have no transform; generic group children do.

key_decisions.title: Drag write-back in percentages; named anchors only when untouched
Selection chrome = outline + 8 resize handles
key_decisions.rationale: Direct manipulation including resize, not just nudge.

key_decisions.title: Resize: anchor-fixed (opposite stays), corner=free, shift=aspect lock
key_decisions.rationale: Standard Figma; transform.anchor preserved as authoring intent.

key_decisions.title: Edge cases: hidden non-selectable; empty deselects; drop writes %; locked fully skipped
key_decisions.rationale: Bundled tightening of behavior so no surprises.

commits.message: checkpoint-1: path-tagged DOM + click-to-select top-level layer
checkpoint-2: drill-in selection + cmd-click backgrounds + deselect
